summary: Tested 7 features: mobile page-turn animation (portrait + landscape), navbar icon backgrounds, delete book from dashboard, admin panel delete user button, admin delete user confirmation modal, and DELETE /api/admin/users/{user_id} API. All features working. Fixed one backend bug (500→401 for unauthenticated delete request).

minor.issue: Returned 500 (instead of 401) when called without auth credentials. Root cause: server.py uses HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) so credentials=None when no auth header, but get_admin_user did not null-check credentials before calling credentials.credentials. FIXED: Added null check to raise 401.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 features from iteration 63 verified working. Backend admin delete user API fully functional. Server.py get_admin_user had a 500 bug when called without auth (now fixed - returns 401). The admin panel uses data-testid='delete-user-{email}' for delete buttons. The book reader on mobile uses AnimatePresence with mobilePageVariants (x: ±100%) for slide transitions on both portrait (390x844) and landscape (844x390). Navbar icons use mix-blend-multiply + dark:invert CSS classes. Dashboard BookActionsDropdown uses data-testid='book-actions-{id}' and 'action-delete-{id}'.

rca_of_issues.root_cause: server.py line 753: security = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False). When no Authorization header is provided, HTTPBearer sets credentials=None instead of raising 403. The get_admin_user function immediately tried credentials.credentials without checking for None, causing AttributeError -> unhandled 500.
rca_of_issues.fix_applied: Added 'if not credentials: raise HTTPException(status_code=401)' at start of get_admin_user function in server.py
rca_of_issues.reproduction: curl -X DELETE https://azories-fixes.preview.emergentagent.com/api/admin/users/any-id (without Authorization header) -> was 500, now 401
